line: Let's! Play! Some! HOCKEY!!!

GO, GO, GO!!

LET'S GO, FOGHORNS!!!
Bring it in! Foghorns, on three! One, two, three!
FOGHORNS!!!
Now it's time to greet your Team Riley! Playing in his thirteenth year and fresh from the Penalty Box, it's Riley's Andy!
LET ME AT 'EM!!!
Whoo!
Helmet, pads, gloves, safety check list is complete! It should be nothin' but smooth sailing from-- AHH!!! LOOK OUT!!!
And that's Frank! Keepin' Riley on her toes!

BLECH!!!

28! Andersen! Tripping!

Oh! We got a penalty…!
That's right! Steve is in da house!
Yay…
Andersen goes to the box 2 minutes for tripping!
Okay, looks like we have a couple of minutes while Riley takes a breather, let me catch you up. Riley is still exceptional.
Ta-Da!
Oh. Yum!
And not just because she's the top of her class, which by the way, she is…
Riley! Riley! Over here!
She's also really kind. And she's nice to stray cats, I mean, come on! Oh! And she's officially a teenager now! She got very tall. Very fast.
Did we grow overnight?!
Oh. That was our favorite shirt…
We even got braces with extra rubber bands!
How does it feel?
Great!
Ow!
Sorry.
Riley's Personality Islands are still going strong.
Glad to see Boy Band Island finally broke up.
But Goofball is still monkeyin' around!
Wait, where's Family Island?
It's right there!
Oh! There it is. Uh, what's that blocking it?
Oh! That's Friendship Island! Isn't it amazing?
But we realized her islands aren't the only things made by memories. Way down at the root level, these memories were also creating beliefs.
Homework should be illegal.
Get Up and Glow is the best band ever!
And my personal favorite?
I'm a really good friend.
Did you know the change in your couch could change the world--!
Oh, no. We should do somethin'.
No! That girl is a social titanic! Do not get on that ship!
Uh, guys?
It's okay. I drop things all the time. I'm Riley.
I'm Grace.
I'm Bree.
Turns out when you put all those beliefs together, they make the most wonderful thing of all: Her Sense of Self.
I'm a good person.
It's what helps Riley make good choices. Thirteen years of hard work all wrapped up and some might call our masterpiece. You know one of our hardest challenges-- Oh! Back to the game!
We're tied!
How are we gonna score on time?!
Whe use our slap shot!
No, no, no! We charge the goalie!
But Grace hasn't scored yet!
Riley's got this.
Thread the needle!
Come on, Riley.
AWOOGA!!!
AWOOGA!!!
AWOOGA!!!
AWOOGA!!!
THAT'S WHAT I'M TALKIN' ABOUT!!
GO RILEY!!!
LOOK AT THAT!!! THAT'S MY GIRL!!!
The Foghorns win the championships!
She shoots, and she scores!
Hey girls. Congratulations on your win.
That's the high school coach!
What a game! That last play? Whoo! The three of you were impressive.
Thanks Coach Roberts.
Look, it's last minute, but every year, I do a 3 day skills camp. I invite all the best players in the area. I love for you girls to come.
Are we in a dream right now? Please can somebody pinch me?
Definitely awake.
If we impress coach, she'll put the 3 of us on the team next year.
Ooh, the Fire Hawks. Finally a team I can get behind.
What do ya say?
YES!! Thank you, coach! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
YES!!
YES!!
Great. We'll see you tomorrow.
What a big day.
Ha! You are such an all star. Oh, you're gonna knock the coach's skates off. Hockey scholarship, here we come.
Dad, stop! It's just hockey camp. I mean who knows what'll happen.
Oooh.
That penalty almost lost us the game today. What if I get to camp and I screw it up?
Hey, don't talk like that.
Yeah. You did great today honey.
Exactly! Mom gets it.
Yeah, I guess.
We are so proud of you.
Night monkey.
All right, all right. Sleep tight honey.
Oh, Riley's so hard on herself.
But, we can make everything easier. Behold!
My Super High Tech Riley Protection System.

Don't look it's fine. This is for all those memories that belong in the back of the mind. Like this penalty one. It's weighing on her so let's lighten the load. A one-way expressway to "We're not gonna think about that right now". Whoo!
??? Jane.
That's pretty impressive.
You take such good care of Riley.
Thanks, I try. Okay, let's do a sweep.
Oh. Here's one where she waved at a guy who was actually waving at a girl behind her.
Oh, that was so bad. Good choice.
Oh, Here's when she forgot that girl's name.
Oh yeah. that was super awkward.
What was her name?
I don't know. Janet or something? Whatever. Let's just get rid of them. We keep the best and... toss the rest! Whoo! Nice work everyone. Alright Andy, the rest of these babies can go to Long Term.
Okay, let's get some shut eye. Big day tomorrow.
Jane, are you taking that where I think you're taking that?
Wanna come this time?
Yes. I, I mean no. I, oh no. I, I, I really shouldn't.
Ya know, You're the only one who hasn't been to the Belief System.
Yeah, its just that it's new, and I know how important it is, and I don't wanna mess it up or break it or burn it to the ground or anything.
Steve, you won't hurt it, I promise. Have I ever steered you wrong before?
Yeah. Many times.
Come on. Where I go, you go.
Oh my goodness.
Whoa.
Mom and Dad are proud of me.
An oldie, but a goodie.
I'm kind.
Aw, that's nice.
I'm strong. I'm brave. I'm a really good friend.
I'm a winner.
And all those beliefs come together to make our Riley.
I'm a good person.
What the heck is that?
Turn that off, Jane!
People, it's the apocalypse!
No! What are you doing?!
Um... Okay.
Whoo! Problem solved.
Jane?
Okay, let’s clear it all out. It’s demo day!
Demo?! Wait, wait, what’s happening?
What’s going on?!
Whoa, whoa, whoa.
Who are you people?
Hey uh, are the one in charge here. Could you do me a favor and stop tearing Headquarters apart?
No can do. Didn’t you hear? Permits just came through.
Permits? For-for what?
For expanding the place. You know, for the others.
What others?
They’re not here yet? Ayayay. Hey Margie, you got that console?
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Give me a sec.
Hey, hey! What are you doing?
Alright, she’s all set.
Set with what?
Come on, Riley, get up! Camp time.
Lunch break!
Wa-wa-wait, wait! You can’t leave it like this.
Don’t worry. We’ll be back.
Come on, we’re gonna be late. Let’s go.
Oh no-no-no-no-no-no-no-no-no-no!
Riley, you aren’t packed yet?
Argh! You’re always on me! Can’t you just lay off for like one second?!
Uh, overreact much.
I barely touched it. Those morons broke the console.
Riley, what’s wrong?
Oh. Mom looks sad.
I’m the WORST!
Oh no. Honey...
I barely touched it.
That’s what I said.
Let the professional handle this.
I’m too gross to go to camp or anywhere ever again!
Oh yeah, this is totally broken.
Well, we all knew this day would come.
Remember, we agreed not to make a big deal about this.
But she really does stink.
Oh, it's bad.
Remain calm. Stick to the prepared script.
You are not gross, honey. You’re just changing. Remember that beautiful butterfly we saw in the park last week?
Well, that butterfly began as a caterpillar. And just like that caterpillar, you're about to get your wings.
Easy… easy…
But if you have questions...
My gosh, mom! Just go away! Ugh!
Well, that’s a preview of the next ten years.
Riley! We're gonna have so much fun!
Oh my gosh!
Alright, who’s ready for hockey camp?
Okay, until we can figure this out, nobody touch the console unless you really need to.
So, big weekend for us? What do you want to do?
We can finally clean out the garage or-
I’m so excited.
Me too!
I know! How great is next year gonna be? Coach Robert’s team has been state champs like, every year. And Val Ortiz is the captain now.
This Valentina Ortiz obsession is out of control.
Uh, she made the Fire Hawks when she was only a freshman.
That’s really hard.
All we have to do is be super awesome at camp, coach will put us on the team and we'll be Fire Hawks.
Wait, what was that?
What was what?
We got a look. I don’t like this.
What? You're paranoid.
I never miss a look.
Enhance 224, one seventy six. Track right, zoom in, right... there!
So?
She’s hiding something! But what?
What is she doing?
She's looking at our look!
No, it’s much more than that.
She looks the same to me.
Overlay and compare. See? Riley then, Riley now. Riley then, Riley now.
It's so obvious.
But what does it mean?
She’s knows we’re hiding something.
What is happening right now?
I don’t know. I don't know!
I can’t take this anymore!
You spilled the tea!
Coach Roberts isn’t gonna be our coach next year!
Grace!
We... we got assigned to a different high school.
Aha! ...Oh. Oh no.
Oh, okay. Um, Yeah. No big deal.
This is a huge spill! I can't breathe!
Is she serious right now? How long have they known this?
Our life! It's over! We can't go to high school without Bree and Grace!
We don't know anybody.
We’ll still get to hang out.
And we'll have this weekend. Which means we’ll get one last time playing on the same team.
Friends are forever, right?
Yeah. Of course.
I can’t wait to get to the rink.
When do we get our schedules?
Oh, this is so sad.
No wait, Steve!
Don't do it!
I don't have a good grip!
No-no-no-no! Listen, just keep it together until we’re out of the car.
Here we are. This looks really cool. You sure you don’t need an assistant coach, cause I am available.
Bill!
No? Alright. See you in a few days.
Have fun.
Okay, bye.
Wait, Riley. Are you sure you have everything? Stick?
Yes.
Gloves?
Yes.
Do you have your phone?
Yes of course.
Full charged?
Yeah it’s like fifty.
What?
Dad, it's fine.
Okay. Call us if you need us. I love you. Go get ‘em.
Okay. Love you guys.
Don’t forget the deodorant.
Mom.
Bye monkey.
Okay, now.  [Steve touches the console and Riley tears up.)
It’s okay. We need this.
Guys, these are high schoolers. We do not want to be red and puffy, do we?
No.
Don’t worry, we’ll have plenty of time to think about this after camp. Now where did Bree and Grace go? Oh, there they are.
Wait, aren’t those traitors dead to us?
Our best friends? No.
Oh!
Hey. Are you okay?
Everybody act regular! It’s Valentina Ortiz!
We gotta say something!
Hey. Hi. I’m Val.
I know. You're the varsity captain. You set the all time goal record as a junior. Your favorite color's red. And your skates are-
What are we saying?
We're so uncool.
Why are we still holding her hand!?
#NAME?
Oh. You're the one coach told us about. Riley, from Michigan, right?
It's Minnesota, sweetie!
No-no-no-no! We cannot correct Val Ortiz.
Yeah, that’s me. Riley from good old Michigan.
Orange? Who made the console orange?
Do I look orange?
I didn’t touch it.
Orange is not my color.
Not me.
Hello, everybody!
WAH!
Oh my gosh. I am just such a huge fan of yours!  And now, here I am meeting you, face to face. Okay. How can I help?
Uh...
I can take notes, get coffee, manage your calendar, walk your dog, carry your things, watch you sleep.
Wow, you have a lot of energy. Maybe you could just stay in once place.
Anything. Just call my name and I’m here for you.
Okay, love that. What was your name again?
Oh! I’m sorry. I can ahead of myself. I’m Alex. I’m one of Riley’s new emotions and we are just super jazzed to be here.  Where can I put my stuff?
Ah-ah-ah. What do you mean "we"?
I wish I was as tall as all of you.
Who the heck are you?
I’m Enrique. Oh, look at your hair.
Oh yeah. Not happening.
Look at her hair! We need hair like that!
My gosh, I love the red in your hair.
Oh.-
What are you doing?!
Hey, maybe you wanna make the team? I can join team red head, too. Yeah, yeah!
Okay, who’s this guy?
What’s your name, big fella?
That’s Embarrassment. He’s not really big on eye contact or like good talking, but he’s a really sweet guy.
Well, welcome to Headquarters, Embarrassment. Oh. We're doin' a fist- No. Oh. No? Goin' high. You got a real sweaty palm there, buddy.
Hey. You wanna come with me actually? We can meet some of the other Fire Hawks.
Oh, this is exciting. But we can’t let her know we’re excited.
Yeah, sounds cool.
What emotion was that?
That’s Pierre.
En- what?
Pierre . It’s what you would call the boredom.
Well, come on up here, En-wer. Am I saying it right? En-wha. No. Oh! Nicknames! I’m gonna call you Oui-Oui.
Non.
How are you driving?
Console app.
Hey! Stop it. That’s enough.

Now, now, I know new emotions can sometimes feel unhelpful at first and you just wanna...say to them. "Why are you so annoying?" But, I've learned that every emotion is good for Riley. Even this turkey.
Okay, fine.
Cool. Lead the way.
Alright, grab your stuff and follow me.
Oh, but what about our friends?
Val is our future.
Yes. I agree completely. We need new friends or else we’ll be totally alone in high school. Right, Jane?
Well, I mean maybe.
Here we go.
Wait up! Thanks for showing me around.
Wait! Why did you do that?
Sorry, what did I do?
We just left our best friends behind.
But what about the new ones we’re about to meet?
No. Okay, these next three days need to be about Bree and Grace.
Jane, th-the next three days could determine the next four years of our lives.
I think that’s overstating things a bit.
Ooh la la… Jane is so old school.
What?

Look, we all have a job to do. You make Riley happy, Steve makes her sad, Frank protects her from the scary stuff she can see and my job is to protect her from the scary stuff she can’t see. I plan for the future. Oh! I can show you. You’re gonna love this.
Oh, I was using that as a cupholder.

Okay. So my team has run all the data and we’re looking at the following likely scenarios. First, we don’t take this camp seriously and we goof off with Bree and Grace. Riley looks really uncool in front of Val. She fails to impress the coach, does not become a Fire Hawk and finally arrives at high school. She has no one, she eats alone and only the teachers know her name.
Ew!
Okay, you and I are gonna be friends.
Oh, this is a sad story.
It's a ridiculous story.  Look, again, Love the energy but you’re being silly. None of this will actually happen.
Right, whatever you say, you're the boss.
Remember when we all finally came up to Headquarters?
That was like thirty seconds ago, Nancy.
Yeah, those were the days.
Nancy! You aren't supposed to be here yet! You still have about ten years, two graduations, and a best friend's wedding before you're invited, but I will keep you in the loop I promise!
Alright, you ready Riley?
Hey, hey, everybody focus. Val’s leading us into their holy inner sanctum.
Here we are.
These girls are so cool!
And older. We are not changing in front of them.
It's fine. Locker rooms are places of mutual respect.
Hey. Come on. I want you to meet the other Fire Hawks.
Hey.
Riley is from Michigan.
Okay, we’re stuck with that.
Oh cool. Where in Michigan are you from?
Uh...
Oh no. What now?
Okay. Looks like we’re committing to this. Cities in Michigan.
We need to make something up.
I'm from all over.
Nice. See ya out there.
Hey, you wanna sit with us?
Oh she wants to sit with us!  Everything is beautiful.
There’s not enough room for Bree and Grace. Oh. Let's go sit over there.
I was gonna go save seats for my friends, but thanks anyway.
Oh. Uh, yeah. Okay. No worries.
See, was that so hard?
No, you’re totally right. That decision’s not gonna haunt us for the rest our lives at all.
Bree and Grace!
Time to celebrate!
Say Awoooga!
Awoooga!
Awoooga!
Awoooga!
Alright ladies, let’s all settle in.
Uh, Jane?
Ladies, settle in means settle down. I need your focus, which means now I'm gonna need your cell phones. All of them.
Ah-ah-ah! You’re here to work. Not goof around, Got that Andersen?
Yes, coach.
Please put all your phones in the basket. You can get them back at the end of camp.
Wow, the coach is so serious.
Jane, I’m just curious. Maybe um, I could…
Thank you. Not now.
I know, right?
You think this is funny. Uh-huh. Well you know what else is funny? Skating lines. Now hit the ice, ladies!
Great job, Michigan.
Thanks a lot, new girl.
Bravo Jane. She's totally fitting in now.
Oh, thanks so much, Oui-Oui.
You're lagging behind Andersen! Skate harder!
Alright ladies, take a breather. Then we'll divide you into teams.
That Michigan girl is off to rough stuff.
Oh no, are they talking about us?
Yeah. There’s no way coach is putting her on the team if she can’t get it together
Uh, okay Dani. Like you had it all together when you were a freshman?
Ugh! I wasn’t that immature.
Oh.  I got you, big guy.
Oh, I always wanted people to talk about us but not like this.
Oh Jane, what do we do now?
Um, we can just um...
I have an idea.
Okay.
If we can get Val on our side, everything will be great.
Uh, Val?
Oh. Hey Riley, what’s up?
Uh-uh, I... I’m so sorry. I didn't mean to get the whole team skating lines. I feel terrible. I respect you so much, I would never do anything to mess you up.
Uh, that’s laying it on a bit thick, don’t you think?
Shh. Jane.
You're a great hockey player and you lead the team so amazingly and I-I-I really look up to you.
Okay, okay. Thanks. Listen, coach was pretty hard on you today. But it's not a bad thing. It means you're on her radar
Really?
Listen, I'm glad you came to talk with me. Hey, let’s try to be on the same team later. Okay?
Oh, yeah. Cool.
Wow. I wish I could do that!
Good job. Wow.
Wow!
Oh, you guys, I mean it really wasn’t anything. I'm just trying to help.
I agree. Great job, Alex. I step back, you stepped in, you got Riley back on track, now I’m ready to step back in.
Uh, but that was just part one of my plan.
There’s a part two?
A good plan has many parts, Jane.
Okay ladies, we’re gonna form your teams for the rest of camp. Now split yourselves down the middle. Team one on the right, team two on the left.
Let’s do this.
We’re on the same team, right?
Right.
Val wants us!
But we promised Bree and Grace.
Jane, we have to plan for the future.
Come on, Riley, move. Move those feet. Val's on team one, you want to be on team one, let’s go!
She made a promise to her friends. She’s not gonna break it.
Oh, you’re so right, Jane.
What are you doing?
No, you can’t have that! Put that back!
Jane, I don’t mean to overstep, but it has to be done!
Wait, what are you — no!
No…
I know change is scary, bu-but watch.
Alright, welcome to our team, Michigan.
That is not Riley.
I know, it’s a better Riley.
A Riley who won’t be alone next year.
We build her a new sense of self, a brand new her.
No no no! You can't go down there with that.
Over my dead flaming body!
I am truly sorry. I was so looking forward to working with you guys.
What do you think you're doing?
Get off me!
Riley’s life is more complex now. It requires more specific emotions than all of you. You just aren’t what she needs anymore, Jane.
How dare you madam?
You can’t just bottle us up!
Oh, that’s a great idea.
It’s not forever, it’s just until Riley makes varsity or until she turns eighteen, or ma-maybe forever. I don't know. We'll have to see. Uh, bye!
Alex! Riley needs us!
Okay. Don’t worry, Riley. You're in good hands. Now let's change everything about you.
Quick question: How do we build a new Riley, which I'm loving by the way. Amazing concept, if it took them thirteen years to build the old one?
Well, good news is we’re not starting from scratch.
I wanna plant one.
Next time.
If I'm a Fire Hawk, I won’t be alone.
We’re gonna be here forever!
Where are you putting us?
The same place we keep all of Riley's secrets.
We’re not secrets.
Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. We’re not secrets, we’re making a big mistake.
Never heard that before.
We are suppressed emotions!
Poor Riley!
Get us out right now out of here!
We don't belong in a jar!
No no no. Riley’s gonna be fine. Totally fine.
Hey there. You know what we call that? Denial. Can you say denial?
Ah!
Hi friends. Welcome! It’s so good to have you here with us today.
It’s Bloofy!
From that preschool show Riley used to like?
That’s right and here’s a little secret.  Riley still likes the show. Stomp like an elephant, Scurry like a mouse! Make your way down to Bloofy's House!
Please kill me.
Bloofy, we’re in a real pickle, could you help us get out of here?
Uh oh, we’re gonna need your help. Can you find a way out?
Who are you talking to?
My friends.  Do you see a key? I don’t either.
Okay, we’re doomed.
Indeed. Welcome to your eternal fate.
Lance Slashblade?!
But he’s a video game character. Why is he here?
Yeah, I always thought Riley had a secret crush on him.
I never saw the appeal.
I long to be a hero, but darkness haunts my past.
Oh, I didn't knew.
Oh, I get it.
I'm in a 100 percent.
I just wanna brush his hair.
Uh, who’s that?
That’s Riley’s Deep Dark Secret.
Wha- What is the secret?
You don’t want to know.
Riley’s secrets, a rogue emotion has taken over Headquarters. Now if you could just open the jar...
Hey kids. Let's learn some Latin. Do you know quid pro quo? We get you out of that jar, then you can get us out of this safe.
No Bloofy. Their destiny is not ours to change. We were all banished here. Dented unfit. Worthless.
Don’t you dare say that. You do not deserve to be thrown away.
Uh, one second, Lance. Don't you remember his power move?
I'm coming for you Riley!
Oh yeah? Watch this!
Come on!
You listen to me, Lance Slashblade. No one is totally worthless.
But I am a warrior cursed with a feeble attack.
Then you must make your curse your gift.
Shield yourselves my friends. For I shall set you all free!
Hey, little help?
Great job, Dark Secret. Now it’s your turn to help us. My pouch has just the thing to get us out of here. Everybody say “Oh, Pouchy!”
Oh, Pouchy!
Hi, everybody. I’m Pouchy!
Pouchy, we need to escape. Do you have anything that can help us?
I have lots of items. Which one do you think will work the best? A tomato? A frog? Or exploding dynamite?
Oh, for cryin' out loud!
Yay, we did it, everyone! Let's all sing the "We did it" song!
NO TIME!!!
Thank you, friends. I must.. I must be leaving you.
What about Dark Secret?
Not yet.
Yeah, that’s probably best for everybody.
Hey! Who let you out?! Get back in there!
What are we gonna do?
Oh, disgusted one, as you once believed in me, I will now believe in myself.
What?
What’s happening?! Hey, hey!
Frank, help!
Hold on!
Lance!
Goodbye, friends! Hello, destiny!
Well, there's a lift for every pop. Come on!
What do we do? What do we do?
Andy, stop! Where are you going?
Um, back to Headquarters? To help Riley!
Riley’s not up there. She’s out there. We can’t go back without her sense of self.
You want us to go all the way to the back of the mind? Are you out of your mind?
Jane, how do we-
Freeze!
Come on!
Hold it right there!
How do we get there? Do you even have a plan, Jane?
I bet Alex would have a really good plan.

Of course I have a plan. Who doesn’t have a plan? Look, she’s not the only one who can forget the future. First, all we have to do is um… give me second. Oh! Follow the stream of consciousness, And then we take a nice easy float all the way to the back of the mind.
Where all the bad memories are.
Exactly. And there we’ll find the Riley we know and love. We’ll put her sense of self back and then Riley will be Riley again.
Okay, I’m gonna give it to you. That could actually work.
Yeah, it could! And then I tell Alex: “Hey, don’t worry so much anymore”, and she’ll say. “Wow Jane, I never thought of that before. Thank you." And then we hug and become best friends.
And then I punt her into the dump.
Wh- No! Andy!
Okay fine. no punting.
Don’t worry. I know right where the stream is. Steve and I have been here before. Oh.
Jane, this is a dead end.
Those are the worst kinds of ends!
Everything's changing so fast.
So, we’re lost.
No, you're never lost if you're havin' fun!
No one is having fun, Jane.
Oh come on, look at Steve. She’s havin' a great time!
I thought you knew where you were going.
I do. I did. I, I just need a moment.
She doesn't know.
We’re stuck here!
Oh! Riley’s awake.
Wait, she’s up too early. What are they doing to her? Come on! We’ll find another way. Don’t worry, Riley. We’re coming.
Why are we up so early?
Because mon ami, we need to speed things up. And that means we hit the ice early and practice like we've never practiced before.
Aren't we already good at hockey?
We’re good, but the Fire Hawks are great.
That's right. Every time we miss, we skate a lap around the rink. Hockey is not a game, it is a sport.
That was amazing.
We need to be that good every time. Let’s run it again.
Hey, I see I'm not the only one who likes to start early.
You guys, it’s Val. We had the same idea!
We’re basically the same person. We’re gonna be best friends.
How long have we been here?
I-I don't know. Maybe an hour? I just wanted to get in some extra ice time.
I’m the same way.
Oh my gosh. She gets us.
See? I told the other girls you'd figure it out. You get what it takes to be the best.
Look at us. This is going great.
Yeah, but we need Val to really like us.
